Field Descriptions

ndmreset_request

NDM Request from Cluster [0:NDMRESET_CLUSTER_COUNT]. Read-only field that reflects incoming NDM reset requests. Connected from ndmreset_request_i input port. Also connected to SMC interrupts. Supports up to 32 CPU Clusters
